context: Hiroshi-elder gets a smart watch from family; learns to use it.
purpose: Elder embracing modern tech with family help.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、これ、スマートウォッチ。
lines.style: Bright, eager presentation. Crisp attack on the word 'smartwatch' — she's proud of it. Warm, unselfconscious cheerfulness. Slight lifting at the end, like she's offering something precious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: Wow — it does more than just tell time!
lines.style: Genuine awe. Slow, appreciative pause before 'more.' Soft Kansai warmth in the vowels. The delight of someone discovering what his granddaughter has brought him.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 健康、記録してくれるよ。
lines.en: It keeps track of your health for you.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact kindness. Steady, instructive pace without talking down. Warmth underneath — she's explaining something that matters to her. Slight emphasis on 'your,' making it personal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 便利な時代やな、ほんま。
lines.en: We really do live in a convenient time, don't we.
lines.style: Reflective, gently philosophical. Kansai lilt on the ending. Quiet wonder at how things have changed. Not lecturing — just observing aloud, with soft gratitude in the tone.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Please stay healthy for a long time.
lines.style: Tender, sincere wish. Soft open vowels. No performance — just genuine care spoken quietly. Slight tremor of feeling underneath, carefully held. Trailing off gently at the end.
